accuracy.evidence: Trial figures come from Bastani et al., PNAS 2025 (nearly 1,000 high school maths students): the answer-giving GPT Base raised practice scores by 48% and the hint-giving GPT Tutor by 127%, and once access was removed the GPT Base group scored 17% below the control group while GPT Tutor was not significantly different. Coursework rules follow JCQ AI Use in Assessments (April 2025): copying or paraphrasing AI content is misuse, acknowledgement must give the tool name and date, keep a non-editable copy of prompts and output, and briefly explain how it was used; centres may restrict use; AI tools can produce fake references.

misconceptions.evidence: Targets the mistakes named in the adult text: trusting fluent, well-set-out AI working, treating 'are you sure?' or a repeated answer as a check, believing rewording AI text makes it your own, thinking research help needs no acknowledgement, citing a source the AI invented, and assuming higher practice scores with AI mean more learning. Each has its own feedback line in the lab or challenge.

lab_distinct.evidence: Mechanics are specific to using AI help: sorting six real requests into builds learning versus does it for you, tapping the first faulty line in an AI's algebra and running a substitution test that shows 35 instead of 27, a real-check meter that rejects fake checks with reasons, revealing a two-round bar chart from a real trial and picking the group that did worst, and building a JCQ-style acknowledgement. The distinctness gate passed against all other flag labs, including Asking for Help and Teaching It Back.

lab_teaches.evidence: Learners find each idea by acting: a wrong sort explains whether the thinking was skipped, tapping a later line says it follows correctly so look earlier, the substitution exposes the slip and the fix gives x = 5 with 3 × 9 = 27, a fake check flashes red with why it proves nothing, and the reveal shows practice up but exam down for the answer AI. Each finished step states the rule in one sentence.

predictions.evidence: Three locked predictions with tempting wrong options: that an AI answer with every step shown must be right, that asking the AI 'are you sure?' counts as a check, and how the answer-AI group did in the exam (better, about the same or worse). The substitution, the check meter and the bar chart then show the answer, and the reveal refers to the learner's pick.

challenge_feedback.evidence: Five rotating scenarios (unacknowledged essay plan, revising with AI, an AI's 15% of 80, a study nobody can find, being stuck on homework) with every wrong option mapped to a specific reason, for example 'Rewording AI work and calling it yours is still malpractice' and 'A number is not proof. 10% of 80 is 8, so 15% must be more than 10.'

readability.evidence: Kid text scores Flesch-Kincaid grade 4.1 (learner limit 6.5) and adult text 7.9 (limit 9.5). Key terms such as malpractice and acknowledgement are explained by what they require, and lab cards are one or two short sentences.

no_filler.evidence: The content gate found no filler. Kid paragraphs cover building versus replacing learning, the trial result, checking AI answers and coursework rules; the adult text gives the evidence base, what the lab does, named mistakes and one routine for home.

mobile.evidence: Checked on 360 px Android light and iPhone 13 dark screenshots before and after Show me at every step. The first version let the AI chat title collide with line 1 and printed '0 ≈ same' into the next bar, so the lines moved down and the label became '≈ same'. Sort bins, working lines, check cards, chart and acknowledgement rows stay readable, and every canvas target has a labelled button twin.

accessibility.evidence: axe found no WCAG 2.1 AA violations in either theme. The canvas aria-label and live status line read the state (request being sorted and bin counts, faulty line chosen and whether the answer was tested, checks picked, which results are shown, parts included), every action works by labelled buttons, and challenge feedback is announced in a polite live region.
